build_segmenter_head: build a SegmenterMaskTransformerHead for semantic segmentation with configurable transformer layers and attention heads
initialize_transformer_layers: initialize transformer encoder layers with stochastic depth and configurable dropout rates in SegmenterMaskTransformerHead
init_weights: initialize SegmenterMaskTransformerHead weights using truncated normal distribution for all linear and layer norm modules
forward_segmentation_masks: run forward pass through SegmenterMaskTransformerHead to produce normalized segmentation masks from input feature maps
review_cls_embedding: review the learnable class embedding parameter and patch projection logic in SegmenterMaskTransformerHead
